channel.title: Running Your AI Agents: AEBOK Explained
channel.description: AI agents can now answer your customers, post for you, chase invoices and prepare your books. The question is not whether they can do the work. It is what they are allowed to do, who approves it, and who answers when it goes wrong. Rabi Jay, author of three books on enterprise AI and founder of AEBOK, the Autonomous Enterprise Body of Knowledge, works through it with Dave, who runs a small online marketplace and is switching on his agents one at a time. Dave is invented. The agents and the mistakes are real.

item.title: The first deliverable that decides for you
item.description:
Dave switched on his first agent last night and it sent eleven emails before he went to bed. Rabi starts with the thirty seconds every owner says at the door when they leave someone in charge, and why nobody is saying it to AI agents. What AEBOK is, in plain words. Why an AI agent is the first tool a business has bought that takes over part of the deciding. And the rule for the series: nothing gets switched on without its line.
Readiness quiz: https://autonomousenterpriseai.com/readiness-quiz Owners' group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/HeLeFUhqdbYKYxou4n723i
Planned and drafted with Anthropic Claude, extensively edited. Rabi's voice is his authorised synthetic voice. Dave is an invented character voiced by AI. Shop and Save is a fictional business.
